Name: Add queue depth alerting across worker fleet
Description: Owner: Kofi. Add queue depth alerts for the entire worker fleet (not just payment workers) with consistent thresholds: warning at 1,000 jobs and page at 5,000 jobs. Acceptance criteria: alerts configured and verified for all worker types.

Name: Fix payment worker retry logic with backoff and dead-letter queue
Description: Owner: Marta. Fix the retry logic in payment_worker.py, specifically the _process_with_retry function. Implement exponential backoff with jitter, cap the number of retries, and on terminal failure route jobs to a dead-letter queue at the back rather than re-enqueuing at the front of the main queue. Add tests that simulate processor 503 responses to cover the retry-storm scenario. Acceptance criteria: no immediate retries, bounded retry count, failed jobs land in dead-letter queue, and new tests pass.
